item.content:encoded:
Anthropic is inviting undergraduate, graduate, PhD students and postdoctoral researchers to apply for its Claude Campus Ambassador Program. Selected ambassadors will receive a USD 3,600 cash stipend while leading AI-focused activities, workshops, discussions and research events on campus.

Key Details

  • Host organisation: Anthropic
  • Opportunity: Claude Campus Ambassador Program
  • Who can apply: Undergraduate students, graduate students, PhD students and postdoctoral researchers
  • Benefits: USD 3,600 cash stipend
  • Focus areas: Artificial intelligence, AI building, education, research and science
  • Programme tracks: Claude Builder Club, Claude Campus Conversations and Claude for Science
  • Application deadline: September 12 at 11:59pm PT
  • Location: University campuses / student communities worldwide
  • Apply: Apply Now

Supporting Student Builders

Lead Student-Driven AI Initiatives with Support from Anthropic

The Claude Campus Ambassador Program is back, with applications open for builders, thinkers and researchers.

The programme provides students with an opportunity to bring AI fluency to their campuses, connect with other students interested in artificial intelligence, organise events and workshops, and engage with Anthropic teams.

The programme has three tracks depending on your level of study and interests.

Undergraduate Students – Claude Builder Club

Build Something Real

If you’re passionate about bringing AI fluency to your campus, apply to lead a Claude Builder Club.

As a Claude Builder Club ambassador, you will:

  • Collaborate with Anthropic to establish and lead a club for AI builders on your campus
  • Organise technical and non-technical workshops featuring Anthropic guest speakers
  • Run hackathons and demo nights for student builders
  • Share regular updates, tips and resources, including API credits, with members
  • Receive a USD 3,600 cash stipend

The official programme materials describe this track as an opportunity to lead a Claude Builder Club, organise workshops, run hackathons and share API credits with other members.

Graduate Students – Claude Campus Conversations

Lead the Conversation

If you’re a STEM or humanities master’s student passionate about ensuring AI has a positive impact on education and society, you can apply to lead Claude Campus Conversations.

You will:

  • Host discussion groups and events with fellow students on the big questions in AI and society
  • Help students build AI fluency by creating spaces to showcase and discuss their Claude builds
  • Visit the Anthropic office and connect with the global ambassador community
  • Receive a USD 3,600 cash stipend

The programme focuses on creating spaces where students can discuss important questions around AI and share their work and builds.

PhD Students & Postdoctoral Researchers – Claude for Science

Take Your Research Further

If you’re a PhD student or postdoctoral researcher using AI to advance research, apply to lead Claude for Science workshops for fellow researchers.

You will:

  • Lead a community of AI-native PhD scientists and postdocs on your campus
  • Organise Claude for Science workshops
  • Join speaker events with Anthropic’s math and science teams
  • Build your expertise on how AI is changing science fields
  • Engage with Anthropic scientists through workshops and research
  • Receive a USD 3,600 cash stipend

The programme materials specifically highlight Claude for Science workshops, speaker events and engagement with Anthropic’s math and science teams on student programming and research.

Why Become a Claude Campus Ambassador?

Joining the programme gives students the opportunity to develop their AI knowledge while building communities and connecting with Anthropic.

Access AI Workshops Led by Anthropic

Gain AI skills while collaborating with Anthropic’s teams to bring AI fluency to your campus.

Find Your People

Connect with students from around the world who see the potential for AI to expand human flourishing.

Help Shape the Future of Claude

Engage with Anthropic teams on Claude features and product ideas. Your feedback can influence Claude’s development.

How Much Does the Claude Campus Ambassador Program Pay?

Selected ambassadors receive a USD 3,600 cash stipend.

This makes the Claude Campus Ambassador Program a paid student opportunity for undergraduate students, graduate students, PhD students and postdoctoral researchers participating in the relevant programme tracks.

Claude Campus Ambassador Application Deadline

Applications close at 11:59pm PT on September 12.

If you are interested in becoming a Claude Campus Ambassador, apply before the deadline.

👉 Apply Now

APPLY FOR THE CLAUDE CAMPUS AMBASSADOR PROGRAM

The programme materials also direct applicants to Anthropic’s campus page at anthropic.com/campus.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is the Claude Campus Ambassador Program paid?

Yes. Selected ambassadors receive a USD 3,600 cash stipend.

Who can apply?

The programme has opportunities for undergraduates, graduate students, PhD students and postdoctoral researchers, with different tracks for each group.

What are the three programme tracks?

The three tracks are:

  1. Claude Builder Club – for undergraduate students
  2. Claude Campus Conversations – for graduate students
  3. Claude for Science – for PhD students and postdoctoral researchers

When is the application deadline?

Applications close September 12 at 11:59pm PT.

Where can I apply?

Applicants can apply through the programme’s application form.

Apply Now →
